steps.request: I want to use Azure SQL Database with DTU-based pricing for a global payment API.
steps.answer: I recommend Azure SQL Database vCore with zone redundancy and active geo-replication because a global payment API needs independently scalable compute and explicit recovery objectives. Use managed identity, least-privilege RBAC, private endpoints, Key Vault, encryption, and monitored failover to apply Zero Trust controls. The trade-off is higher baseline cost and operational testing. Main risks are regional failover lag and capacity limits; validate RTO, RPO, peak TPS, and data-residency constraints before committing. Evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/database/high-availability-sla-local-zone-redundancy

steps.request: List the next steps to move forward safely.
steps.answer: Next, confirm peak and steady transaction rates, latency targets, budget, residency, RTO, and RPO. Then benchmark vCore tiers, test zone and regional failover, verify least-privilege access and private connectivity, and record the selected tier with its cost and recovery trade-offs. Evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/reliability/reliability-azure-sql-database
